skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Defeat enemies with melee weapons to level this skill.

buff.name: Reduced Melee Stamina Drain
buff.summary: Reduces the cost of stamina using melee weapons by 0.5% per level to 49% total stamina reduction at level 99.

unlocks.name: Parry
unlocks.description: Parry attacks by blocking at the last moment to stagger your enemies and deal increased damage!

unlocks.name: Melee Weapon Special Actions
unlocks.description: Unlocks unique special actions for melee weapons!

unlocks.name: Tempest Shield
unlocks.description: Conjure a shield of air magic that prevents all damage for a limited time while blocking, triggering a powerful burst when spell ends. Attack levels increase duration.

unlocks.name: Sprint Attacks
unlocks.description: Unlocks the ability to perform a Unique Sprint Attack action after sprinting for a short distance.

unlocks.name: Weapon Expertise
unlocks.description: Unlocks additional attacks for all melee weapons.

unlocks.name: Enchant Weapon: Fire
unlocks.description: Enchant your current melee weapon with the power of fire! Apply Burning to enemies with critical hits!

unlocks.name: Adaptability
unlocks.description: Evading or blocking no longer interrupts your combos when using a melee weapon!

unlocks.name: Weapon Rack
unlocks.description: Unlocks the ability to build a weapon rack to display your weapons.

unlocks.name: Enchant Weapon: Air
unlocks.description: Enchant your current melee weapon with the power of air! Increases your melee weapon's attack speed.

unlocks.name: Lesser Attack Potion
unlocks.description: Unlock the recipe for the lesser Attack potion at the brewing cauldron.

unlocks.name: Training Dummy
unlocks.description: Unlocks the ability to build a training dummy to test your melee weapons on.

unlocks.name: Whetstone
unlocks.description: Allows crafting of whetstones at the crafting table, which can be used to sharpen melee weapons for increased damage!

unlocks.name: Enchant Weapon: Water
unlocks.description: Enchant your current Melee weapon with the power of Water! Strike enemies with Water damage and occasionally create healing orbs to restore health.

unlocks.name: Tempest Shield Upgrade
unlocks.description: Your shield now lasts longer.

unlocks.name: Attack Skillcape
unlocks.description: Unlocks the ability to wear and craft the Attack skillcape and its trimmed variant.

skills.name: Ranged
skills.description: Defeat enemies with ranged weapons to level this skill.

buff.name: Ammo Recovery Chance
buff.summary: Increases the chance to recover ammo (bolt/arrow) per level.

unlocks.name: Quick Action
unlocks.description: Perform Quick Actions with ranged weapons using the Primary Action button.

unlocks.name: Archery Target
unlocks.description: Build an archery target to practice your Ranged accuracy against. Shoot the bullseye for a surprise!

unlocks.name: Trick Shot
unlocks.description: After firing a fully drawn arrow, release follow-up shots at exactly the right time for 15% increased damage!

unlocks.name: Snare
unlocks.description: Conjure earth magic at your feet and lay a trap for your enemies! Those caught inside become rooted in place for a short time.

unlocks.name: Toxic Behaviour
unlocks.description: Unlocks the recipe for weapon poison, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Poison or to craft Poisonous arrows.

unlocks.name: Hunter's Sense
unlocks.description: Crouch for a short time to activate your Hunter's Sense, allowing you to sense nearby creatures and enemies.

unlocks.name: Make 'Em Bleed
unlocks.description: Unlocks the recipe for weapon barbs, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Bleed or to craft Barbed arrows.

unlocks.name: Spectral Arrows
unlocks.description: Enchant your equipped bow with astral magic, causing arrows to penetrate multiple targets.

unlocks.name: Crossbow Trick Shot
unlocks.description: Trick Shot now applies to crossbow weapons. Fire at the right time to instantly finish reloading and ready your next shot!

unlocks.name: Enchanted Crossbow Bolts
unlocks.description: Unlocks the ability to craft Enchanted Crossbow Bolts. Enchanted bolts have a chance of triggering unique magical effects when fired!

unlocks.name: Venomous Trapper
unlocks.description: The Snare Trap now triggers a cloud of poison when activated, causing enemies stuck inside it to become poisoned over time.

unlocks.name: Fire Starter
unlocks.description: Unlocks the fire oil and fire arrows recipes, giving you new ways to burn your enemies to ash!

unlocks.name: Lucky Bolts
unlocks.description: Increases the chance for enchanted crossbow bolts to trigger their magical effects.

unlocks.name: Ranged Skillcape
unlocks.description: Unlocks the ability to wear and create the Ranged skillcape and its trimmed variant at the crafting table.

skills.name: Magic
skills.description: Defeat enemies with magic to level this skill.

buff.name: Reduced Magic Stamina
buff.summary: Reduces the cost of magical stamina drain by 0.5% per level.

unlocks.name: Air Magic
unlocks.description: Summon the unrelenting force of air! Equip air runes to unleash the power of wind against an enemy, dealing high single target damage and knocking your enemies down!

unlocks.name: Secondary Attacks
unlocks.description: Charge up and release powerful secondary staff spells.

unlocks.name: Water Magic
unlocks.description: Conjure the supportive power of water! Equip water runes to damage and slow your enemies while also healing yourself and your allies. Kills with water magic have a chance to spawn water orbs.

unlocks.name: Surge
unlocks.description: Channel arcane power into your dodges, travelling further and evading longer as a result.

unlocks.name: Arcane Expertise
unlocks.description: Unlocks an additional powerful magical attack at the end of staff magic combos.

unlocks.name: Runic Refund
unlocks.description: Your greater understanding of magic gives you a 30% chance to preserve runes when attacking with magic.

unlocks.name: Fire Magic
unlocks.description: Wield the destructive forces of fire. Equip fire runes to deal medium damage to enemies in a large area and build up Burning on them to reduce them to ash

unlocks.name: Afterimage
unlocks.description: Distract your enemies by leaving behind an illusionary image for a short time when you use your first Surge charge.

unlocks.name: Confuse
unlocks.description: Twist the minds of lesser enemies, making them unable to distinguish between friend and foe for a limited time.

unlocks.name: Magic Potion
unlocks.description: Unlock the recipe for the magic potion at the brewing cauldron.

unlocks.name: Magic Focus
unlocks.description: Allows crafting of magic focus at the crafting table, which can be used to imbue magic staves to increase their damage!

unlocks.name: Greater Confuse
unlocks.description: The Confuse spell now works on a wider variety of creatures.

unlocks.name: Enfeeble
unlocks.description: Weakens the attacks of the targeted opponent.

unlocks.name: Vengeance
unlocks.description: A spell that reflects incoming damage back at the enemies.

unlocks.name: Magic Skillcape
unlocks.description: Unlocks the ability to wear and craft the Magic skillcape and its trimmed variant.

skills.name: Farming
skills.description: Grow crops to level this skill.

buff.name: Seed Recovery Chance
buff.summary: Increases the chance to recover seeds from all plants by 0.3% per level, up to 29.4% at level 99.

unlocks.name: Plant Cure
unlocks.description: Unlocks the ability to create plant cures at the cooking range! Use plant cures to heal your plants from disease.

unlocks.name: Rain Catcher
unlocks.description: Collects and filters rain water into usable clean water over time.

unlocks.description: Unlocks the compost bin and compost bucket recipes. These allow for creating and using Normal compost to boost the yield and disease resistance of your plants.

unlocks.description: Channelling the power of the earth, summon a spectral surge that gently coaxes ripe plants from the soil. Within a small radius, all fully grown crops and wild plants are instantly harvested and drawn towards you.

unlocks.description: You are skilled enough at farming to now grow trees! Trees can be planted directly into the ground and seeds can be found while chopping down trees and from birds nests.

unlocks.description: Unlocks the water barrel, which stores Clean or dirty water collected from watering cans for later use.

unlocks.description: With greater mastery over the land, the caster's reach extends even further. Harvester expands Uproot's range to a wider radius.

unlocks.name: Speedy Farmer
unlocks.description: You've become more adept at watering and composting your plants. You can now do so with less penalty to your movement speed!

unlocks.name: Cleansing Rain
unlocks.description: Upgrades the Humidify spell, causing the conjured rain cloud to cure any diseased plants it passes over while watering them.

unlocks.name: Scarecrow
unlocks.description: Unlocks the scarecrow for protecting your farm from feathered annoyances.

unlocks.name: Super Compost Bin
unlocks.description: Unlocks the super compost bin which produces super compost, for an even better yield boost and disease resistance of your plants.

unlocks.name: Rapid Growth
unlocks.description: Advances plant growth by one stage. Cannot be reapplied until the plant grows further.

unlocks.name: Overgrowth Aura
